metadata.title: Annual Survey of Industries policy outcome aggregates
metadata.price_basis: Current rupees. Monetary growth rates must not be described as real growth until deflators are applied.
metadata.universe: Registered factories and other establishments covered by ASI; not all manufacturing activity or employment.
metadata.estimation: Unit values are multiplied by the public-use multiplier. Ratios are ratios of weighted aggregate totals.
metadata.uncertainty: Exact MoSPI RSEs require public-use subsample identifiers that are not present in these files. Cells are graded by unweighted sample count, effective sample size and largest-contributor concentration; cells graded suppress are not exported to JSON.
metadata.disclosure: Public JSON requires at least 10 sampled factories and no factory contributing more than 70 percent of absolute weighted GVA in the cell.
metadata.formula_source: MoSPI ASI 2023-24 Instruction Manual, Annexure VIII and scrutiny formulas; version-specific column names are harmonized in the build script.

sector_definitions.label: All registered manufacturing
sector_definitions.limitation: ASI covers registered factories and selected related establishments, not informal manufacturing.

sector_definitions.label: Food processing and beverages
sector_definitions.limitation: Includes beverage manufacturing; agricultural production and informal processors are outside ASI.

sector_definitions.label: Textiles and apparel
sector_definitions.limitation: Technical textiles cannot be consistently separated across every year.

sector_definitions.label: Leather and footwear
sector_definitions.limitation: Covers registered manufacturing, not retail or home-based production.

sector_definitions.label: Computer, electronic and optical products
sector_definitions.limitation: Semiconductor fabrication and design cannot be cleanly separated from other electronic components in ASI.

sector_definitions.label: Electronics and electrical equipment
sector_definitions.limitation: Broader robustness definition; results should be shown alongside the core electronics definition.

sector_definitions.label: Motor vehicles, bodies and components
sector_definitions.limitation: ASI does not identify electric powertrains separately from conventional vehicles.

sector_definitions.label: Motor vehicles, components and tyres
sector_definitions.limitation: Includes tyres as a robustness definition but not all upstream automotive suppliers.

sector_definitions.label: Pharmaceuticals and medical devices
sector_definitions.limitation: Biotechnology services and standalone R&D centres outside registered factories are not covered.

sector_definitions.label: Aerospace and selected defence manufacturing
sector_definitions.limitation: Many dual-use suppliers sit in broader engineering industries and cannot be identified from NIC alone.

sector_definitions.label: Ships and boats
sector_definitions.limitation: Does not include every marine supplier or port service.

sector_definitions.label: Games and toys
sector_definitions.limitation: Small cells require three-year pooling and disclosure suppression.

sector_definitions.label: Materials recovery
sector_definitions.limitation: Captures recovery establishments covered by ASI, not circular practices within other factories.
